title: Coronally advanced flap with connective tissue graft or xenogeneic acellular dermal matrix in the treatment of multiple gingival recessions: A split-mouth randomized clinical trial. Gürlek Ö, Gümüş P
authors: Nizam N, Buduneli N. J Esthet Restor Dent. 2020 Jun;32(4):380-388. doi: 10.1111/jerd.12547.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss mucoderm (porcine collagen soft-tissue matrix) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Within the limits of the study, M-CAF combined with mucoderm® or CTG seems to be similarly effective in RD reduction of class I and II MGRs at least in the short term. Soft tissue shrinkage and increase in PD may be observed with mucoderm®, while CTG seems to provide stable clinical outcomes for 18 months follow-up” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
